name: Other armed conflicts
summary: Pakistan–Taliban border clashes continue; Moyale fighting sends 50,000 Ethiopians into Kenya
state: Pakistani forces struck Afghan border posts in South Waziristan after cross-border fire, reported on 2 Nov, and mediation remains stalled (Daily Pakistan). In Ethiopia, fighting in Moyale since 18 Oct has driven more than 50,000 people into Kenya, where registration began around 31 Oct (allAfrica, 4 Nov). Neither has become an interstate war or a capital under attack.
for_you: Check FCDO travel advice for Pakistan's border areas, Afghanistan and southern Ethiopia.
rubric_hit: Significant deterioration in conflicts not tracked elsewhere = Watch

why: Wars and flashpoints outside Canary's named list — such as Yemen, Haiti, Ethiopia–Eritrea, Afghanistan–Pakistan, Libya and Somalia — can escalate with little warning.
